description_expanded: ABOUT CHIC SHACK Welcome to Chic Shack, a modern and inviting beach home located in the heart of Panama City Beach, Florida. This spacious 6-bedroom, 4-bathroom private residence sleeps up to 20 guests and offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and proximity to the Gulf - making it ideal for family vacations, group getaways, and relaxed beach gatherings. Just one block from the beach, Chic Shack features a private pool, open-concept living spaces, and an outdoor area ideal for grilling, relaxing, and spending time together. Inside, guests will enjoy Smart TVs in every bedroom, WiFi, washer and dryer, and coastal-inspired furnishings designed for relaxation. The thoughtfully designed bedroom layout offers flexibility for families and groups, including a spacious bunk room perfect for kids or additional guests. Whether you're lounging poolside, cruising to the beach or around the neighborhood in the included 6-seater golf cart and bikes, or enjoying sunset walks along the beach, Chic Shack delivers a comfortable and carefree coastal getaway. ABOUT THE AREA Chic Shack is ideally located in Panama City Beach, just steps from the emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico and within close proximity to popular attractions, shopping, and dining. Nearby attractions include: * Beach access just a 3-minute walk away * Pier Park shopping, dining, and entertainment * Local restaurants and beachside cafés * Outdoor activities, bike paths, and water sports * Easy access to 30A's charming coastal communities * Guests will also enjoy an exclusive invitation to seasonal beach bonfires, included with your stay. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS * One Block from the Beach * 3-Minute Walk to Beach Access * Private Heatable Pool (Heated Upon Request) * Pet Friendly (Approval Required) * 6-Seater Golf Cart Included * 4 Bikes Included * Gas Grill with Propane * Open-Concept Living Spaces * Smart TVs in Every Bedroom PARKING * 4-5 Designated Parking Spaces (Depending on size) PROPERTY RULES * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hours of booking or subject to cancellation * Must be 25 years or older to book * Smoking not permitted * All reservations are non-refundable - we strongly encourage purchasing travel insurance to protect your trip DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first-class service from inquiry to checkout. All homes are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained to the highest standards. Our local team is available 24/7 to ensure your stay is seamless and stress-free. Our mission is to help you create unforgettable memories - one beach vacation at a time.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
